var wave15VisitorLock sync.Mutex
var wave15Delegations int
func wave15DelegatedCallSource(node *ast.Node) (string, bool) {
 wave15Delegations++
 return CallExpressionSource(node)
}
func SourceVisitors(report func(string,*ast.Node)) rule.Listeners {
 var sources []string
 var blamed []*ast.Node
 original := wave15OriginalSourceVisitors(func(source string,node *ast.Node) {
  sources = append(sources,source); blamed = append(blamed,node); report(source,node)
 })
 result := rule.Listeners{}
 for kind, listener := range original {
  result[kind] = func(node *ast.Node) {
   wave15VisitorLock.Lock(); defer wave15VisitorLock.Unlock()
   sources, blamed, wave15Delegations = nil,nil,0
   modulePresent, moduleLiteral, moduleText := false,false,""
   if node != nil && node.Kind == ast.KindImportDeclaration {
    if declaration := node.AsImportDeclaration(); declaration != nil && declaration.ModuleSpecifier != nil {
     modulePresent = true; moduleLiteral = ast.IsStringLiteralLike(declaration.ModuleSpecifier)
     if moduleLiteral { moduleText = declaration.ModuleSpecifier.Text() }
    }
   }
   callSource, callMatches := "",false
   if kind == ast.KindCallExpression { callSource,callMatches = CallExpressionSource(node) }
   listener(node)
   for _, target := range blamed { if target != node { panic("SourceVisitors did not blame its supplied node") } }
   record := struct {
    Kind int; Nil bool; ModulePresent bool; ModuleLiteral bool; ModuleText string
    CallMatches bool; CallSource string; Sources []string; Delegations int
   }{int(kind),node == nil,modulePresent,moduleLiteral,moduleText,callMatches,callSource,sources,wave15Delegations}
   path := os.Getenv("WAVE15_VISITORS_CAPTURE")
   if path != "" {
    data,err := json.Marshal(record); if err != nil { panic(err) }
    file,err := os.OpenFile(path,os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY,0600); if err != nil { panic(err) }
    if _,err = file.Write(append(data,'\n')); err != nil { panic(err) }; if err=file.Close(); err != nil { panic(err) }
   }
  }
 }
 return result
}
